text.text_excerpt: Great food truck serving up awesome barbecue at reasonable prices. I ordered the smoked sausage poboy and it was huge!! He also let me try his burger which was juicy and thick. The fries were crispy and the chicken looked really good too. They do not no the meaning of portion control here. It is go big or go home at this food truck. I hear his ribs are good, as well as his pork chops. If you are not in the mood for pork, they have chicken, all beef burgers, and seafood. They travel all over the city and have a Facebook page so you can keep up with where they'll be. Try them out if you see them.

Ok let's start off by saying this has to be one of the best food trucks and New Orleans. The amount of food you get and the taste of the food Queen on Wheels provides it's a no brainer that you must try them. They know they are so good that they provided free samples of there food before you order. Today I had the BBQ Country Ribs and the White Beans and rice. There is so much food on the plate for $10.00 that I could only eat a small portion of a rib and beans. I can eat lunch and dinner off of the plates Queen's provide. Once you meet the cook and see how friendly he is and the love he has for cooking food for people you will see why he gives out so much food on your plate. Also try the...

I have seen Queen on Wheels on the road, but never had the chance to try it until today at the Gretna Food Truck Fest. The sausage links they grill are massive! I decided on the fried shrimp which were well seasoned, but the bbq sauce stole the show. It is homemade, so I don't have an ingredient list. Sweet, vinegary, and a bit of a kick at the end. If you get the smoked sausage or the link sausage poor boy, get the bbq sauce!
